comments:
This item, kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN), is discussed in <<van der Kuijp 1994 [4TBERVZD]>>: 12-13 and listed in [CTQMVBPR]: 27.
In view of the signature, it was part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi zha 36."
name: tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i 'grel bshad rgyan gyi me tog
provenance:
'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang
CPN 5148(10)
item_description:
Number 48 occurs twice (upper/lower). 
Change of hand from fol. 29.
Miniatures of Dignāga and bCom ldan ral gri on fol. 1b.
Base text written in red ink. Items of the topical outline and quotations in dark red and yellow ink.
The final portion of the colophon cannot be read.
Contains numerous glosses, beginning on fol. 6a and ending on fol. 61a.
